data.rationale: The proposal captures the overall GitHub lookup → email draft procedure and the correct email/subject/body templates, but it omits the blog parameter and the separate-tab visit to the blog (it vaguely says "latest blog post or activity"), adds an unneeded Users filter step, has the ambiguous "Send, or Discard" instead of always discarding, and lists a recipient_email parameter that isn't in the true workflow. An automation would not know which blog URL to visit.
